result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.select_nodes()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Select nodes using a predicate function. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L5379-L5432){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.select_nodes(predicate) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Selection](/assets/graphs/algo-selection.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="A six-node graph with three nodes marked as selected in the accent color; the remaining three nodes are shown with default styling." width="100%"} Applies a custom filter function to all nodes, selecting those for which the predicate returns `True`. The predicate receives a `Node` object with properties: `id`, `label`, and attributes. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [predicate]{.doc-parameter-name} : Function that takes a `Node` object and returns `bool`. Should return `True` to select the nodes. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} The predicate receives each node's `Node` object, so any of its properties -- `id`, `label`, or `attributes` -- can drive the filter. Here, only "hub"-typed nodes pass: ::: {#9dd54237 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A", type="hub", score=10) .add_node(label="B", type="leaf", score=5) .add_node(label="C", type="hub", score=8) .select_nodes(lambda n: n.attributes.get("type") == "hub") ) graph.get_selected_node_ids() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` [3, 1] ``` ::: ::: Filtering on `n.id` instead selects by internal node ID -- useful when IDs carry meaning, such as being assigned in a known order: ::: {#eeb1a587 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph.clear_selection() graph.select_nodes(lambda n: n.id >= 2) graph.get_selected_node_ids() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` [3, 2] ``` ::: :::
